source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of stack uses (PDF 97).

blocks.text: Stacks in kaamon mein istemal hote hain: expressions (hisab wale jumle, jaise 3 + 4 * 2) ka jawab nikalna, function calls sambhalna, parentheses (brackets) ka balance check karna, aur undo. Aaiye inhein ek ek kar ke dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “Sacks” chhapa hai; matlab Stacks hai.

blocks.prompt: Computer mein stacks ke chaar istemal bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Expressions badalna aur hal karna, function calls sambhalna, parentheses ka balance check karna, aur undo.

items: Stack ke istemal: expressions, function calls, parentheses, undo.
